venues.parkingDetail: There are a limited number of parking spaces available in the National Bowling Stadium parking lot. There are also many public and private lots situated near the Events Center. generalInfo.generalRule: NO Audio NO Video NO Smoking anywhere inside the Reno Events Center. There is a designated smoking area provided outside Portal A.
generalInfo.childRule: All Ages are welcome. For most events no ticket is required for ages 0-23months, as long as the child does not occupy a seat of their own. For events such as "Sesame Street", "Barney", or "Dragon Tales", a ticket is required for anyone 12 months or older.
